writeup: TIC 9586662 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 1.1131 days. Automated analysis of TESS photometry detected a primary eclipse causing a 2.77 percent dimming of the star's light, with a box least-squares detection signal-to-noise of 84.1. Pixel-level image analysis produced a difference-imaging peak signal-to-noise of 6.2, though the centroid offset of 10.8 arcsec from the target position warrants attention. No secondary eclipse was detected, and the candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs. The machine-learning screening score of 0.46 suggests moderate confidence in this target. All data quality checks passed without flags.
